item.title: Best Coffee in Brunswick — 2026 Local Guide
item.description: Brunswick takes its coffee personally. This is a suburb where people will argue about extraction times over a $4.50 flat white, where roasteries operate out of converted warehouses on side streets you would walk past without noticing, and where the barista knows your order before you reach the counter. The inner north’s coffee scene has been strong for decades, but in 2026, Brunswick specifically has become something of a coffee destination — not just for Melbourne, but nationally.
